meta.method: Search-index reconstruction. Direct crawling was blocked; run scripts/crawl-inventory.ts to fill verbatimBody, media and lastModified for every item and to enumerate pages not in the index (shop products, form fields).

verbatimStatusValues.fragment: one or more sentences captured verbatim from the search index; the rest of the page is not captured
verbatimStatusValues.missing: nothing captured; page known only by URL or title

notes: Rewrites never replace originals; they sit in proposedRewrite beside verbatimFragments.
Legal and financial strings (ABN, fees, contact) appear only where verified against a source and carry a verified flag; see docs/blockers.md F1-F19.
Animal slugs are normalised to name-haartid; the redirect map covers the two WordPress fallback slugs and the un-suffixed ones.

page.title: About Our Rescue

verbatimFragments.text: A group of like-minded individuals came together from other rescues with the idea of doing things different. From this we have grown to the rescue we are today.
HAART is a Not-For-Profit Charitable organisation that saves the lives of hundreds of animals each year, supported only by the generosity of the general public for our funding.

We don't have a premises with hundreds of animals awaiting adoption. Instead, we have a team of dedicated foster carers – people just like yourselves – who take scared, abused, and unwanted animals into their homes, give them the gift of life, and love them like their own, until we find them the perfect forever home.
verbatimFragments.note: Pet Fresh's rescue-groups page republishes this in third person; site wording first person per index

verbatimFragments.text: HAART is exclusively no-kill and do not put animals to sleep just because they don't have room.
Our goal is to see the day when we are no longer needed.

verbatimFragments.text: By welcoming an animal into your home you are saving them from the streets, the pound or potentially being put to sleep.

verbatimFragments: HAART is a not for profit and 100% volunteer run rescue based in Perth, WA.
We are foster based, meaning our dogs are kept in loving family homes until adopted.
Within seven days we will call to discuss your application, then arrange a home check to ensure the home and fencing are suitable, as the safety of our dogs is of the utmost importance.

verbatimFragments: HAART is a not-for-profit, 100% no-kill animal rescue charity based in Perth, Western Australia.
Each year, HAART rescues and re-homes 100's of animals that would otherwise be euthanised, go homeless or continue to be neglected.
HAART relies solely on the generosity of the general public and supporters for all funding and receives no government or local authority funding.
Since HAART was founded in January 2012, countless animals' lives have been saved.
rehomes unwanted pets from local pounds and private surrenders, and assists with vaccinations, microchips and sterilisation to rehome dogs/puppies
educates the public about animal welfare
Pet Fresh is a proud supporter of many rescue charities in Perth, having held many fundraisers for G.A.W.A and H.A.A.R.T.
